name: Centurion Marcus Aquilinus
background: Twenty years in the legions, half of them spent putting down things no official report ever named correctly.

talents.name: Seen Worse
talents.description: Once per scene, when confronted with a Mythos horror, Centurion Aquilinus may spend 1 Momentum to treat the encounter as a Difficulty 1 Fear test instead of whatever the GM would otherwise set.

traits: Speaks in clipped orders even off duty. Touches the amulet under his armor before every fight.
notes: Nemesis-tier. Commands a squad of 4-6 Legionary Thug minions (see cultist_thug.json for the minion stat-block shape) in most encounters.
